race.comment: CELESTIAL RULER (9) is the top pick despite an unplaced start to this campaign, with her Pakenham seventh coming in metro company and the move into an easier assignment looking significant. She gets weight relief, is third-up, and the extra ground gives her a chance to settle into the race better than she has. Can give this a shake. BREWSTER BUCK (6) was well held numerically at Morphettville Parks, but he made ground from back in the field in Saturday company and his earlier fourth at this track had excuses. Include. IMPENDING FURY (4) resumes after a break with a genuine forgive run on his Strathalbyn record, having raced keenly and wide without cover. Barrier one gives him every chance to return in better order. One to consider. BELFAST BOY (1) hasn't really produced this campaign but worth consideration today.
